artifacts.summary: Identifies the cause (the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint's post-deploy reconcile pass only ever considers tasks named in the current /orchestrate invocation's own task_numbers, never a system-wide scan of specs/state.json), traces the 2026-10-07 incident through git history to confirm it, resolves the regeneration-is-manual-only.md vs. lint sanctioned-site divergence (commands/implement.md no longer exists), and recommends widening run_post_deploy_reconcile_pass() in scripts/lib/redeploy-checkpoint-lib.sh to sweep state.json system-wide, with a reproduction fixture plan.

memory_candidates.content: In this agent system's /orchestrate batch engine, the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint's post-deploy reconcile pass (run_post_deploy_reconcile_pass in scripts/lib/redeploy-checkpoint-lib.sh) only promotes deploy-pending tasks that are members of the CURRENT invocation's own task_numbers (see orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's deploy_pending_any loop over mt_get_json '.task_numbers'). A task refused by the postflight completion-deploy gate (exit 6) in one /orchestrate invocation is invisible to this mechanism in any later invocation that does not name that same task number again -- it requires a hand-run reconcile-task-status.sh call instead. This is a reusable diagnostic pattern for any future investigation of 'stranded deploy-pending task' reports.

scripts/tests/test-lint-deploy-caller-wrap.sh mechanically re-derives every genuine deploy-headless.sh caller on every run (never a hardcoded list) and is the authoritative source for the 'exactly two sanctioned automated deploy-trigger sites' count. context/patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md can drift stale relative to it -- confirmed in this task by a dangling reference to commands/implement.md, a file that no longer exists in the source store. When reconciling a documented-vs-mechanical divergence about deploy-trigger call sites, trust the lint, not the prose.
